heroDescription: Build long-form books with chapters, version history, PDF layouts and reflowable EPUB output.
importMarkdownDescription: Convert a Markdown manuscript into a book.
convertVersionDescription: Create a compatibility copy in another MDW format version.
convertDialogBody: A new .mdw copy will be created. The source book is never modified. Version 1 is the original single-Markdown format. Version 3 is the current chapter-based format.
noRecentBooks: Your recent books will appear here.
oldBookmark: This recent book was saved by an older Markweft version. Use Open book once and select it again so macOS can save persistent access.
bookmarkRestoreFailed: Unable to restore macOS permission for this book. Open it once with Open book to refresh access. ({error})
